attchmntText: Eros International Media Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP

Eros International Media Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations"),  that Mr. Pradeep Kumar Dwivedi, Group Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Eros Media World PLC, (Isle of Man Company No: 007466V) has tendered his resignation from the said position, vide his resignation letter dated 27th November 2026. The resignation shall be effective from the close of business hours on 30th November 2026.'
voiceSummary: Eros International Media Limited intimates that Mr. Pradeep Kumar Dwivedi, Group Chief Executive Officer of Eros Media World PLC, has tendered his resignation. The resignation letter is dated 27th November 2026. The resignation becomes effective from the close of business hours on 30th November 2026. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Eros International Media Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Mr. Pradeep Kumar Dwivedi as Chief Executive Officer, Key Managerial Personnel and Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Eros International Media Limited has received the resignation of Mr. Pradeep Kumar Dwivedi, DIN 07780146, from the positions of Chief Executive Officer, Key Managerial Personnel, and Executive Director. The resignation was submitted via a letter dated 27th November 2026 due to personal reasons. The cessation of his roles is effective from the close of business hours on 30th November 2026. Mr. Dwivedi confirmed there are no other material reasons for his departure. He served as a member of the Audit Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee. He automatically ceased to be a member of these committees with effect from 30th November 2026. The Board expressed appreciation for his contributions during his tenure.
